page.title: Stoneware mug, pair at the shop

product.name: Stoneware mug, pair
product.description: Set it out for two cups of tea after a short afternoon at the pottery yard, packed in paper and a cardboard edge, batch river loft eighty.

blocks.text: It left a board mill on Sunday evening after an enamel fire, and the batch is birch peg thirty six.
A board maker packed it in paper and a cardboard edge because the glaze stays even, batch amber stall forty nine.
The mugs are speckled stoneware and sold as a pair, batch iron drawer twenty three.

presentation.review_line: These are the rows on this order.
